senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (वलते)
1 To cover.
2 To move.
3 To surround or enclose.
r. 10th cl. (वालयति)
To cherish or maintain.

n. (-लं)
An army, forces.
E.
वल to surround, aff. अच्; see बल.

r. 1st cl. (वल्लते)
1 To cover.
2 To move.

m. (-ल्लः)
1 Winnowing corn.
2 A Māṣa of silver.
3 A weight of three Rattis.
4 Prohibiting, prohibition.
5 Covering.
E.
वल्ल to move, &c., अच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
White.
m. (-क्षः)
White, the colour.
E.
वल to go, aff. क्विप्; वल् going, अक्ष to pervade, aff. अच्; also बलक्ष, and अवलक्ष.

m. (-गुः)
The moon.
E.
वलक्ष white, गौ a ray of light, the final vowel changed.

mn. (-ग्नः-ग्नं)
The middle; also अवलग्न.

mf. (-भिः-भी)
1 The wooden frame of a thatch.
2 A turret or temporary building on the roof of a house.
E.
वल to cover, अभस् aff., इन् and ङीष् added; also वडभि.

m. (-म्बः)
A perpendicular.
E.
अव, and लवि to depend, घञ् aff., the initial rejected; also अवलम्ब.

mn. (-यः-यं)
A bracelet, an armlet.
m. (-यः)
1 Sore throat, inflammation of the larynx, &c.
2 A boundary, an inclosure.
E.
वल to surround, कयन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Surrounded, encompassed.
E.
वलय an inclosure, aff. इतच्.

f. (-का-की)
A small kind of crane.
E.
वल to surround, aff. आकन्; also बलाका.

m. (-कः)
1 A bracelet.
2 A finger-ring.
E.
वल to surround, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-कः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
2 A frog.

m. (-कः)
1 A cloud.
2 A mountain.
3 A Daitya, a demon.
4 One of the Nāgas.
5 One of the horses of KṚṢṆA'S car.
E.
वलाका a crane, हा to go, aff. नु, deriv. irr.

f. (-लिः)
1 A line or streak made with fragrant unguents on the person.
2 Natural line or folds of skin, a wrinkle.
3 Offerings to the spirits of air.
E.
वल to surround, aff. इन्; see बलि.

f. (-ल्लिः-ल्ली)
1 A creeper, a climbing or creeping plant.
f. (-ल्लिः)
The earth.
f. (-ल्ली)
A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)
E.
वल्ल to cover, इन् aff., and ङीप् occasionally added.

mn. (-कः-कं)
The edge of a thatch.
E.
वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. इकक्.

f. (-या)
1 Making lines on the person.
2 Making offerings^1 to all beings.
E.
वलि, and क्रिया act; see बलि, &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Moved, constrained.
2 Surrounded.
E.
वल to go, क्त aff.

nf. (-शं-शिः or -शी)
A fish-hook.
E.
वटिन् a bait, शो to destroy, aff. ड, ट changed to ड, and ड again interchangeable with ल.

n. (-कं)
The root of the lotus.
m. (-कः)
A bird.
E.
वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. ऊक.

r. 10th cl. (वल्कयति)
To speak.

n. (-ल्कं)
1 The bark of a tree.
2 The scales of a fish.
E.
वल to surround, कक् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्की-ल्कं)
Made of the bark of trees.
E.
वल्क bark, aff. अण्.

mn. (-लः-लं)
1 The bark of a tree.
2 A garment made of bark.
E.
वल to surround, कलच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Made of bark.
f. (-ली)
Spirituous liquor.
n. (-लं)
A dress made of the bark of trees worn by ascetics.
E.
वल्कल bark, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having scales or bark, wearing a dress made of the bark of trees, &c.
m. (-वान्)
A fish.
E.
वल्क a scale, &c., मतुप् possess. aff.

m. (-लः)
A thorn.
E.
वल्क bark, इलच् aff.

n. (-तं)
Bark, rind.
E.
वल to surround, कुतच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (वल्गति)
1 To go or move.
2 To go by leaps, to jump.

f. (-ल्गा)
A bridle, a rein.
E.
वल्ग to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-ल्गन्-ल्गान्ती-ल्गत्)
1 Going.
2 Jumping.
E.
वल्ग to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Leaped, jumped, gone by bounds or leaps.
n. (-तं)
1 Running.
2 A horse's gallop.
E.
वल्ग to go by jumps, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु)
Handsome, beautiful.
m. (-ल्गुः)
A goat.
E.
वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. उ, and गुक् augment.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Handsome, beautiful.
n. (-कं)
1 Sandal.
2 A wood.
3 Price.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-त्रः)
A wild sort of pulse; see वनमुद्र.

m. (-लः)
The flying fox.
f. (-ला)
A sort of bird.

f. (-का)
A cockroach.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Become handsome or beautiful.
E.
वल्गु used as a verb, शतृ aff.

r. 1st cl. (वल्भते)
To eat.

n. (-नं)
1 Eating.
2 Food.
E.
वल्भ to eat, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eaten.
E.
वल्भ to eat, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
An ant-hill; also वल्भीक.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A hillock, ground thrown up by moles, &c., but especially the large accumulations of soil, sometimes made by the white ant.
m. (-कः)
1 The poet VĀLMĪKI.
2 Elephantiasis, or swellings of the neck, chest, hands and feet, which break and discharge ichor in many places.
E.
बल to cover, or बल to live, कीकच् Uṇādi aff., and मुम् augment; in the latter case this word and the corresponding ones are written बल्भीक, &c.; also वल्मिक, वल्मीकि.

m. (-कः)
VĀLMĪKA or VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa.
E.
वल्मीक an ant-hill, aff. अण्, or with इञ् aff. वाल्मीकि; so immersed in abstraction as to be overrun with ant's nests.

m. (-किः)
An ant-hill; also वल्भीकि.

m. (-किः)
The author of the Rāmāyaṇa; also वाल्मीकि.

वल्युल and वल्यूल
r. 10th cl. (वल्यूलयति)
1 To cut
2 To purify.

f. (-की)
The Vīṇā, or Indian lute.
E.
वल्ल to cover, aff. क्वुन्.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
1 Beloved, desired, dear.
2 Supreme, superintending.
m. (-भः)
1 A lover, a husband, a friend.
2 A horse with good marks.
3 A superintendant, an overseer.
4 The chief herdsman.
f. (-भा)
A mistress, a wife.
E.
वल्ल to cover, अभच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A groom, a horse-keeper.
E.
वल्लभ a good horse, and पालक who cherishes.

f. (-रिः or -री)
1 A compound pedicle.
2 A creeping or twining plant.
E.
वल्ल to cover, अरन् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 A cook.
2 A herdsman.
3 A name of BHĪMASENA.
f. (-वी)
A cowherdess.
E.
वल्ल covering, and व aff.

n. (-जं)
Pepper.
E.
वल्ली a creeper, and ज born.

n. (-रं)
1 An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creeping plants.
2 An uncultivated field or place overrun with wild grass.
3 A sand, a desart, a place destitute of water.
4 A field.
5 A compound pedicle.
6 A solitude, a wild.
7 A thicket, a wood.
E.
वल्ल to cover, उर aff.; also बल्लूर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं).
1 Dried flesh.
2 Hog's flesh, the flesh of the wild hog.
n. (-रं)
1 An uncultivated field, or one overrun with grass.
2 A thicket.
3 A desart.
E.
वल्ल to cover, ऊर Uṇādi aff.

f. (-ल्ल्या)
Emblic myrobalan.
E.
वल्ल to cover, यत् aff.

m. (-जः)
A sort of coarse grass, (Eleusine Indica.)
E.
वल्ल to cover, deriv. irr.

r. 1st cl. (वल्हते) r. 10th cl. (वल्हयति)
To speak or tell.
r. 1st cl. (वल्हते)
1 To kill or hurt.
2 To cover.
3 To be preeminent; in which sense it is more properly बल्ह.
r. 10th cl. (वल्हयति)
To shine.
